note: Values are the CURRENT build. They supersede the hex list in earlier session briefs (see drift.supersedes).

drift.supersedes: pre-2026-07-26 palette (bg #0a0d12, panel #0f131a, acc #7dd3a0, positions b39ddb/4dd0b1/f2a65a/6fa8ff/94a0b0)
drift.reason: Elevation contrast increased and position colours desaturated so saturated amber reads as attention only.

rules.use: names, prose, nav, buttons, labels, section headings

rules.extra: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums scoped to the cell, never global
small size, letter-spacing .045em — these are labels, not measurements

font.hierarchy: weight and colour carry hierarchy, never size

radius.rule: zero radius on data cells and table rows; radius only on chrome

light.note: Own design, not an inversion: elevation rises toward white, accents carry higher chroma

roles.acc: accent 1 — yours / good / on pace / primary action
roles.positions: labels only, deliberately desaturated so they cannot compete with the accents

constraints: Two accents plus semantics. Reserved, never decorative.
Blue/orange is the distinguishing axis. Green/red is never a good/bad axis.
Elevation via lightness steps, not borders. Hairline only where two same-elevation regions abut.
Every colour-carried meaning needs a redundant non-colour cue (number, glyph, weight, or rule).
Team colours are used only for the identity chip and initials background, never as a data colour.

density.tierGrouping: tier header gets a surface lift + player count; the tier is the visual unit
density.numberAlignment: numerics right, text left, CI bounds right-align on the closing paren
density.stickyHeaders: required on any table taller than the viewport, applied consistently
density.bars: always paired with the number; always render a faint track so an empty bar is distinguishable from a missing bar
